verdict.rationale: The first-party README shows a 'VLM session with `llama cli`', and several hands-on reports confirm vision works well. Users ran llama-mtmd-cli with quantized Gemma-3 models, loaded images via '/image', got OCR and photo descriptions, and benchmarked about 15 s per image on an M1. Vision support was once removed but has since been restored, so this is history rather than a current contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of multimodal support (supported model list, image input via the server API) beyond a README caption.
